inputs.text: The real issue is whether public resources are being turned into private profit while political connections shield powerful interests from scrutiny. KT Rama Rao has accused the Congress government of failing to act on illegal mining and alleged that Raghava Constructions, linked to Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, is involved. These are allegations, but they deserve an independent, transparent investigation—not dismissal as political point-scoring. When communities bear the costs and well-connected actors may benefit, accountability and protection of the public interest must come first.
